Case-inflected words expressing vileness are compounded with case-inflected words, expressing contempt and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

, come when the thing is spoken of as contemptible.

Terms: क and अकच् (अक्)

The affix डुपच् (उप) comes in expressing diminution after the word कुतू 'a jar'.

Terms: डुपच् (उप)

A finite verb along with its preceding गति , if any, become अनुदात्त when a noun denoting the fault of the action follows, with the exception of गोत्र etc.

Terms: Accent
